vsam.why: base/cntl/adef121.jcl DEFINE1: DATA(... KEYS(10 0) RECORDSIZE(225 225)); the engine's facts do not read KEYS / RECORDSIZE inside the DATA component, so the case states them

scenarios.name: add-with-counter
scenarios.why: LGACDB01's scenario add-with-counter through LGACUS01: GET COUNTER GENA/GENACUSTNUM: NORMAL, 1000011 (the counter is then 1000012); INSERT CUSTOMER with that number; LINK LGACVS01 writes the VSAM copy; LINK LGACDB02 adds the CUSTOMER_SECURE row; CA-CUSTOMER-NUM 1000011, '00'

scenarios.name: add-without-counter
scenarios.why: LGACDB01's scenario add-without-counter through LGACUS01: no named counter (GET COUNTER is INVREQ RESP2 201, which the program reads as not NORMAL): INSERT with DEFAULT, the identity gives 1000001 (START WITH, restarted each run), SET :H = IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL() reads it back on the INSERT's own connection

scenarios.name: add-blank-optional-fields
scenarios.why: LGACDB01's scenario add-blank-optional-fields through LGACUS01: blank house name / number / phones / email stored as blanks (CHAR), not NULL

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: LGACUS01 moves ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED' to EM-VARIABLE, WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS), IF EIBCALEN > 0 is false, then ABEND LGCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 60 < WS-REQUIRED-CA-LEN 90 (18 + WS-CUSTOMER-LEN 72): CA-RETURN-CODE '98', RETURN before the LINK

notes: GenApp's add-customer front end (LGACUS01, LINKed with the 32500-byte LGCMAREA COMMAREA): it checks the COMMAREA and LINKs LGACDB01 (which LINKs LGACVS01 and LGACDB02) with it. The case runs every program of that chain in the same task ("programs"), LGSTSQ too (its error logger, "region" for its ASSIGN SYSID), with the back-end case's Db2 tables, VSAM file and data; the scenarios reuse genapp-lgacdb01's inputs (each "why" names its source) and add the front end's own paths: no-commarea (EIBCALEN 0: LGSTSQ, ABEND LGCA). short-commarea: EIBCALEN 60 < 90. MOVE '00' TO CA-NUM-POLICIES (bytes 91-93) runs before the length check, so a COMMAREA shorter than 93 bytes is written past EIBCALEN before line 112 is reached: the task is judged up to that reference (X23) and IF EIBCALEN IS LESS THAN WS-REQUIRED-CA-LEN true is unreachable without one (a GenApp defect). WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE's IF EIBCALEN > 0 (and the IF EIBCALEN < 91 inside it) is never true: the paragraph is PERFORMed only when EIBCALEN is zero -- dead in practice, uncovered by every scenario. The SQL faults (M2) are the harness's, one per statement the tasks run.
